response.sql: WITH grouped AS (SELECT c.zoneref, s.insurstat, COUNT(*) AS conservation_count FROM scanconservation AS c INNER JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat), fractions AS (SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_count, CAST(conservation_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(conservation_count) OVER () AS fraction FROM grouped), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fraction DESC) AS fraction_rank FROM fractions) SELECT zoneref, insurstat, conservation_count, fraction FROM ranked WHERE fraction_rank <= 10 ORDER BY fraction DESC, insurstat NULLS LAST, zoneref;
